additional_info.subject: ID0469130-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/R3 312881977020] Charging Issue CRM:03209000077
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex,
We've got feedback from EcoG and now we know how to read the logs from now on if it's a EV stopping the session or if it's us.
Since we've installed the BETA version, the new logic is in place and we can confirm the statement above.
Let me try to explain this, even I had a hard time understanding:
This is your customer's EV, PilotState reading:
What you see here in green is not important, only the Red part. What it indicates is if it's in PilotState B or C.
If it's:
PilotState B is approximately 1780
and
PilotState C is approximately 2020
.
In this case we see a lot of PilotState B measurements (all the ones past 1999, 1st instance or 2004, 2nd instance)
This is an example of how the noise problem looks like:
We can see some ~1780 events followed by a singular ~2020 event which then continues with the PilotState C (~1780).
So from EcoG and our side, this customer's EV requested the session to stop deliberately.
I hope this answered to your question and convey this to the customer.
Please let me know what the customer thinks, if customer faces more of these issues, I can confirm again if it's the EV or us.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
